controles.affirmation: Smartmatic USA Corp reclame 2,7 Mds $ de dommages dans une plainte pour diffamation deposee en fevrier 2021
controles.verbatim_source: the lawsuit filed by Smartmatic USA Corp. and certain of its affiliates (collectively, "Smartmatic") in February 2021 seeking $ 2.7 billion in damages (10-K FY2026)

controles.affirmation: les parties ont plaide les requetes de jugement sommaire le 2 decembre 2025 et aucun proces n'est attendu avant fin 2026 au plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: summary judgment motions in the Smartmatic case on December 2, 2025. At this time, no trial date has been set by the court in the Smartmatic lawsuit and a trial is not expected to commence until later in 2026 at the earliest (10-K FY2026)

controles.affirmation: Fox a deja paye environ 800 M$ pour regler l'affaire Dominion, une plainte similaire, et une action connexe en avril 2023
controles.verbatim_source: including the payment of approximately $800 million to settle the Dominion matter and a related lawsuit in April 2023 (10-K FY2026)

controles.affirmation: Un echec de l'operation Roku pour cause reglementaire declencherait une penalite pouvant atteindre 1,2 Md$ a la charge de Fox, ou 866 M$ dans les autres cas de rupture
controles.verbatim_source: each party will be required to pay the other party a termination fee of approximately $866 million if the Merger Agreement is terminated in certain circumstances [...] In addition, FOX will be required to pay Roku a termination fee of approximately $1.2 billion if the Merger Agreement is terminated under certain circumstances related to the failure to obtain certain regulatory approvals or upon the entry of a permanent restraint under certain antitrust laws or investment screening laws (10-K FY2026)

controles.affirmation: 12,0 Mds $ d'engagements de pret-relais (11,0 Mds $ disponibles au 30 juin 2026) plus 1,0 Md$ de pret a terme, face a 4,2 Mds $ de tresorerie
controles.verbatim_source: the lenders provided $12.0 billion of commitments ($11.0 billion of which is available as of June 30, 2026) to provide senior unsecured bridge loans [...] The Company has approximately $4.2 billion of cash and cash equivalents as of June 30, 2026 (10-K FY2026)

controles.affirmation: Le resultat net attribuable aux actionnaires a recule de 578 M$ (-25,6%), preuve citee : "Net income decreased $566 million or 25% for fiscal 2026"
controles.verbatim_source: Net income attributable to Fox Corporation stockholders $ 1,685 $ 2,263 $ (578) (26) % ; Net income 1,727 2,293 (566) (25) % (10-K FY2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Le chiffre affirme (-578 M$, -25,6%) est exact, mais le verbatim cite en preuve (-566 M$, -25%) porte sur le resultat net TOTAL, pas sur la part attribuable aux actionnaires. Remplacer la citation par la ligne du compte de resultat : 'Net income attributable to Fox Corporation stockholders $1,685 $2,263 $(578) (26)%'.

controles.affirmation: perte de 761 M$ sur la variation de juste valeur de la participation Flutter, contre un gain de 449 M$ un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: Net (losses) gains on investments in equity securities (a) $ ( 761 ) $ 449 $ ( 189 ) (10-K FY2026, Non-operating other, net)

controles.affirmation: Les actions Class A ne votent que dans des circonstances limitees ; LGC Holdco decide seule du vote et de la cession d'environ 38,8% des actions Class B, sous l'autorite exclusive de Lachlan Murdoch
controles.verbatim_source: Holders of Class A Common Stock are entitled to vote only in the limited circumstances set forth in the Company's Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation ; LGC Holdco beneficially owns less than one percent of the outstanding FOX Class A Common Stock and approximately 38.8% of the FOX Class B Common Stock. The voting and disposition of the shares [...] is, subject to certain limited exceptions, decided solely by a managing director of LGC Holdco's sole manager who is appointed, and may be replaced, by Lachlan K. Murdoch (10-K FY2026)

controles.affirmation: Le segment Cable Network Programming pese 43% du chiffre d'affaires sur les exercices 2025 et 2026 ; CA total 17 126 M$ vs 16 300 M$ (+5%) ; EBITDA ajuste 3 906 vs 3 624 M$ (+8%)
controles.verbatim_source: Cable Network Programming (43% of the Company's revenues in fiscal 2026 and 2025) ; Revenues $ 17,126 $ 16,300 $ 826 5 % ; Adjusted EBITDA $ 3,906 $ 3,624 (10-K FY2026)

controles.affirmation: Fox News reste la premiere chaine d'info cablee du pays depuis 24 ans consecutifs
controles.verbatim_source: For over 24 consecutive years, FOX News has been the top-rated national cable news channel in Monday to Friday primetime viewing, according to The Nielsen Company (10-K FY2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Le classement porte sur le prime time du lundi au vendredi, pas sur l'ensemble de la journee. Ecrire : 'premiere chaine d'info cablee du pays en prime time du lundi au vendredi depuis plus de 24 ans consecutifs (source Nielsen citee par la societe)'.

controles.affirmation: Remuneration totale du PDG Lachlan Murdoch : 32,98 M$ pour l'exercice 2025, ratio de 327 fois le salaire median (100 889 $), conseil de 7 membres dont 85,7% independants
controles.verbatim_source: ceo_total_comp_m 32.98, ceo_pay_ratio 327, median_employee_pay 100889, source_fiscal_year 2025, board_size 7, board_independence_pct 85.71 (src/data/v2-pipeline/foxa.json, DEF14A 2025)
